nodes.text: You want to do something that matters and looks like nothing? Lamps. Fat for tallow, an emberstone for the heart. I build the lamp, I stand it one dark mile up the road, and the argument gets one mile shorter.
Liv watches me carry every one out the gate, and writes it down, and says nothing. That is how a no dies, friend. Slowly, in front of witnesses.
The road thanks you in the only way it can. It gets shorter after dark.
